title: English Practice Quiz 0170
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.
